richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nangloi Jat

c: Nangloi Jat is one of west Delhi's most crowded neighbourhoods, along Rohtak Road, where houses stand wall to wall and parks are small and well used. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nangloi Jat for resident welfare associations, schools, the municipal corporation's parks and DDA green areas. Every machine is made at our Vasai factory, about 1120 km away.

We send the equipment to Delhi by road, and our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes it in place. Delhi's climate is harsh on both ends. Summers are very hot, the monsoon is short, and winter brings cold mornings and heavy smog. Galvanised steel handles this well. Since the parks are small, we suggest double machines that let two people train on one footing.

items.q: Can an RWA in Nangloi Jat order outdoor gym equipment directly?
items.a: Yes. RWAs, schools and civic bodies can order from us. Share the park size and photos, approve the layout and quote, and we manufacture and install.

items.q: Are outdoor gyms safe to use on smoggy winter days?
items.a: The machines work in any weather. On days with very poor air quality, users may prefer to exercise later in the day or skip outdoor training.

items.q: What maintenance do the machines need in Delhi?
items.a: Wipe off dust from the handles and joints, tighten loose bolts and check moving parts before summer and after the monsoon. We share a checklist at handover.
